channel.title: Telechat blog
channel.description: Notes on building Telechat — a self-hosted Claude bot for Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack and a local web chat.

item.title: Your Claude Code sessions can page you
item.description: A long agent run stalls on a question you are not there to answer. How Telechat's Desktop bridge turns Claude Code hooks into a Telegram card you can reply to from anywhere — including the recursion where the notifier notified itself.

item.title: One process, four messengers, one SQLite file
item.description: No webhook, no tunnel, no queue, no managed database. How Telechat runs Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack and a web chat from one process — what that buys, what it costs, and the three storage bugs that became design rules.
